title: Private key material served in a response
description: The response body carries a PEM private key block: the BEGIN/END markers and the base64 MII payload that follows them are the shape of an encoded key, not of sample text. A key served by a web endpoint is readable by anyone who can request the path, whatever algorithm it encodes.
remediation: Remove the file from the web root and rotate the key, because a served key must be treated as compromised. Store key material outside the document root and check for accidental inclusion in deployment artefacts.
limitation: One response body. The rule reports the PEM markers and payload shape; it does not validate the key and cannot tell which service the key belongs to.

observation.body:
-----BEGIN DSA PRIVATE KEY-----
EXAMPLEEXAMPLEEXAMPLEEXAMPLEEXAMPLEEXAMPLE
EXAMPLEEXAMPLEEXAMPLEEXAMPLEEXAMPLEEXAMPLE
-----END DSA PRIVATE KEY-----

-----BEGIN DSA PRIVATE KEY-----
EXAMPLEONLYEXAMPLEONLYEXAMPLEONLY
-----END DSA PRIVATE KEY-----
